ENABLED_DETAIL: Hide when you start typing in Discord.
EXCEPTIONS_DETAIL: Enter a comma-separated list of channel IDs.
SHOW_ICON_DETAIL: Add a Silent Typing toggle next to the chat composer controls on iOS.
SHOW_MENU_DETAIL: Add a Silent Typing toggle to the channel’s long-press menu.
COMMAND_DETAIL: Toggle whether others can see that you are typing.
COMMAND_VALUE: True hides your typing. False shows it. Leave blank to toggle.
